post.description: Iran The focal point of the Iranian offensive is now economic strangulation, not a traditional operational breakthrough.
post.truncated_body_text: Iran The focal point of the Iranian offensive is now economic strangulation, not a traditional operational breakthrough. Iran has shifted to a decentralized 'mosaic defense' strategy, maintaining its strike capability despite the decapitation of its top leadership. The IRGC's small-boat fleet has remained largely intact, and Iran is using cluster munitions on its remaining ballistic missiles to maximize damage despite their reduced accuracy.
